he.rel: own/I Chronicles/he/Westminster Leningrad Codex (OSHB, mit Morphologie).json

source.method: Word-by-word review by Claude (November 2026); no automatic links

1:9.note: Token 6 is a stray punctuation mark (plus).

1:11.note: Accusative את rendered by ל; Ludim K/Q both assigned.

2:15.note: Plus 'Elihu the seventh', so David is 'eighth' (cf. 1 Sam 16:10-11).

2:24.note: Plus 'these', 'in the land', 'sons'; 'Hezron's wife Abijah' minus.

2:50.note: 'Father of' rendered 'was born in'; Kiriath-jearim rendered Kiriath-nearin.

2:51.note: 'Father of' rendered 'was born in'; Hareph obscure.

2:52.note: 'Father of' and Haroeh / half Menuhoth minus.

2:54.note: Conflated list of names from MT 2:54-55; plus summary 'these all were sons to Shobal in Kiriath-nearin'.

2:55.note: Conflated list of names from MT 2:54-55; plus summary 'these all were sons to Shobal in Kiriath-nearin'.

3:1.note: 'Who were born to him' minus; plus 'whose name was'; second son named Caleb (MT Daniel); plus 'wife of Nabal'.

3:5.note: Plus 'names of the sons'; 'four, by Bathshua daughter of Ammiel' minus.

3:9.note: 'Besides the sons of the concubines' minus; plus 'these'.

3:17.note: Assir and Shealtiel fused into one name.

3:18.note: List turned into a genealogy with plus 'his son' after each name.

3:19.note: Pedaiah rendered Nedabiah; Shelomith rendered Salqat.

3:20.note: Ohel rendered Jehoel; Jushab-hesed and 'five' minus.

3:23.note: Only two names; Azrikam rendered Azariah.

3:24.note: 'Sons of Elioenai' and 'seven' minus; K/Q both assigned.

4:2.note: Reads 'families of Rehoboam' for 'families of the Zorathites'.

4:3.note: Reads 'sons of Abinadab' for 'father of Etam'; sister Hazelelponi omitted.

4:4.note: Father of Gedor and Ezer omitted; 'who was' and 'from' added.

4:5.note: Names Helah and Naarah omitted; 'to him' added.

4:6.note: 'One of them' replaces Naarah; 'to him' omitted.

4:9.note: Jabez rendered 'one of them'; 'beloved by his mother and father' for 'more honourable than his brothers'; name explanation omitted.

4:10.note: Turned into a blessing addressed to Jabez ('he said to him'), with second-person pronouns.

4:12.note: Expanded into a chain of 'X begot Y'; Irnahash rendered as a name Yaʿzir.

4:15.note: Rewritten as numbered list of six sons (Ela, Naam, Qenaz plus three added names); Iru omitted.

4:19.note: Adds Eshtemaʿ and Ishimon at the end.

4:20.note: Only Amnon matches; other sons and the closing clause repeating 4:19 are pluses.

4:21.note: Only the opening phrase rendered; rest of verse omitted.

4:24.note: Adds Ohad, Yakin, Zohar (from Gen 46:10); closing 'these are sons of Shela son of Judah' is a plus; 'sons of Simeon' moved to next verse. 'Sons of Simeon' from 4:24; Shallum omitted.

4:26.note: Adds 'Shimʿathi his son' for 'sons of Mishma'.

4:27.note: Reads 'until the sons of Judah came to him' for 'like the sons of Judah'.

4:31.note: Town list replaced by different names (Hazar-gadda, Heshmon etc.), treated as pluses.

4:33.note: 'Unto Baal' rendered differently (plus); wehityahsam lahem paraphrased 'and they had a (great) name', then expanded into praise of their dwellings.

4:38.note: 'Who came' and 'increased greatly' omitted; 'who were there' added.

4:40.note: 'From Ham' rendered 'those'; 'good' and 'there was there' added.

4:41.note: Reads המעינים as 'springs of water'; 'by names' omitted; adds 'men', 'all', 'was good'.

4:42.note: Adds 'these are the names of the men who went'; 'these four men' and final 'went at their head' are pluses.

5:1.note: Reads 'and he was smaller (lightly esteemed) on his father's bed'; adds that the blessings came on both over all tribes; genealogy clause omitted.

5:2.note: Paraphrased messianically: 'from Judah shall go forth the King Messiah'; 'prevailed among his brothers' omitted.

5:4.note: Reads 'sons of Carmi' for 'sons of Joel'.

5:5.note: Word-for-word with variant name forms (Uriah, Bela).

5:6.note: 'Head of the tribe of the house of Reuben' expands 'prince of the Reubenites'.

5:9.note: 'He dwelt' omitted; 'unto the border of the desert'.

5:12.note: Targumic reading: Shaphat taken as 'he judged them', ha-mishne as 'he taught them (the books)'; Shapham, Janai, Bashan and 5:13 not rendered.

5:14.note: Variant names; genealogy after Machir/Michael omitted.

5:18.note: Number 44,666 (six hundred, extra 'six') vs MT 44,760; adds 'all these'.

5:19.note: Hagrites rendered 'dwellers of Saka'; Jetur, Naphish, Nodab omitted.

5:20.note: 'They were helped against them' and 'all who were with them' omitted.

5:22.note: 'From their tents' added; 'because the war was of God' and 'until the exile' omitted.

5:23.note: Double rendering of rabu ('multiplied and grew'); adds 'mountain', 'great', 'unto Hartman'; 'they' omitted.

5:26.note: Pul omitted; Hara rendered 'cities of Media'; adds 'and they dwell there'.

5:41.note: 'Was taken captive' for 'went'; adds 'men of' and 'to Babylon'.

6:11.note: 'Sons of Elkanah' omitted; adds Zerah, Shmaela, Mari with 'his son'.

6:13.note: Reads Joel for Vashni (cf. 6:18); 'and the name of his second son' added.

6:16.note: 'Over the service of song' omitted; 'to minister', 'all' and 'that was placed there' added.

6:18.note: 'From the families of the Levites' added; 'the singer, son of' omitted, giving 'Heman and Joel'.

6:31.note: Amzi and Bani omitted; Shamer rendered Natur.

6:33.note: 'House of the tabernacle of the house of the Lord'.

6:39.note: 'Names of the cities which fell to the families' for 'their dwellings by encampments'; 'first' added.

6:40.note: 'All the villages around it in the land of Judah'.

6:42.note: Adds 'all', 'they gave to the priests' and suburbs for Hebron and Jattir.

6:52.note: Gezer rendered Yaʿzir; 'tribe of the house of' added.

6:62.note: 'From the tribe of the house of Merari'.

6:64.note: Mephaath placed before Jahaz. Mephaath appears in 6:63; Maʿon and its suburbs added.

6:65.note: Tribe of Gad and Gilead omitted.

7:1.note: Adds 'these are his four sons' framing.

7:2.note: Adds 'these are the sons of' and 'by their families'.

7:3.note: Four heads instead of five; Uzzi rendered Uzzar.

7:4.note: 'With them' omitted; 'mighty men of valour and makers of war' for 'bands of the army of war'.

7:6.note: List expanded after Gen 46:21 (Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, Ard); Jediael rendered Ashbel; 'three' omitted.

7:11.note: Jediael rendered Ashkol; 'by their families' added.

7:12.note: Ir rendered Gur; Aher omitted, 'sons of Hushai'.

7:14.note: Reads 'Edomite' for 'Aramean'; Asriel follows the concubine.

7:15.note: 'Daughter of nobles' for 'for Huppim and Shuppim'; 'elder brother'; explicit 'had no sons but daughters'; ethic dative with 'took'.

7:16.note: Reads 'mother of Machir' for 'wife of Machir'.

7:17.note: Reads 'sons of Reqem' for 'sons of Ulam'.

7:19.note: List continues as objects of 'she bore'; Likhi omitted.

7:21.note: Elead omitted; 'killed them' omitted; 'sons of Gath'.

7:22.note: Adds 'and to speak to his heart'.

7:24.note: Sheerah rendered 'who was left'; 'she built' omitted.

7:25.note: Rephah interpreted as 'Asyath (healer)' with explanatory plus; rest omitted.

7:27.note: 'From the sons of Nun the father of Joshua'.

8:1.note: Adds Akbar (Becher) as second son; Ashbel (Ashkol) third; Aharah omitted.

8:2.note: Nohah and Rapha replaced by Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, Ard (Gen 46:21) numbered to ten.

8:6.note: Ehud rendered Abihur; 'by their families' for 'inhabitants of Geba'; Manahath rendered 'to the plain'.

8:7.note: Only Naaman rendered; rest of verse and 8:8 omitted.

8:10.note: Sons named Manasseh, Saraia, Yarmana, Yasbas instead of MT names.

8:13.note: Beriah, Shema omitted; hemma as 'he was'; parablepsis from yoshve Aijalon to yoshve Gath ('over the inhabitants of' mapped to the first leyoshve, Gath to Gath).

8:16.note: Joha and 'sons of Beriah' omitted; 8:17-22 omitted.

8:32.note: Reads שמאה as 'a hundred'; 'with their brothers' omitted.

8:33.note: Abinadab rendered Ishvi; Eshbaal rendered Ashbeshul.

8:34.note: Adds 'lame in his feet, and Ishvi had a son'.

8:36.note: Reads Meribbaal for Ahaz; Moza rendered Amosia.

8:37.note: Binea rendered 'the Canaanite'; adds 'and the Canaanite begot'.

8:38.note: Azrikam split into Azri and Qim; Bocheru read as 'his firstborn'; ordinals added.

9:1.note: 'Written in the book of the kings of Israel' omitted; adds 'sons of' and 'those sinners'.

9:3.note: Adds 'and from the sons of' before Manasseh.

9:5.note: 'From the place of the Shilonites'; adds 'and Basia his brother'; 'his sons' omitted.

9:9.note: 999 for MT 956; 'mighty men of valour' and 'of hundreds' added.

9:11.note: Reads נגד 'opposite' for נגיד; adds 'who dwelt in his house'.

9:15.note: Bakbakkar replaced by Jeroham; genealogical 'son of' chain added.

9:16.note: 'In Ramtha' for 'in the villages of the Netophathites'.

9:18.note: Reads 'gates' for 'porters'; adds 'which stand in them'.

9:19.note: Korahites and 'the Lord' omitted; 'works' covers melekhet ha'avoda; adds 'men of', 'who stand', 'exits and entrances'.

9:23.note: Adds 'they appointed these for them'; 'to be keepers of' paraphrases 'al (the gates).

9:25.note: Expanded: 'they did not enter except once in seven days'.

9:26.note: Expanded with 'on the four sides of these gates'; 'mighty' omitted.

9:29.note: Adds 'of the Levites', 'the altar', 'pure'; 'vessels' in place of fine flour left as plus; repeated w-'al carries the waw of each listed item.

9:31.note: Adds a clause about the gift of the Levites; Korahite omitted; havittim rendered 'hidden things' (as if from hb').

9:33.note: 'Free' omitted; adds 'keeping in the chambers around the house'.

9:35.note: Jeiel presented as his firstborn son.

9:42.note: Azmaveth omitted; Alemeth made father of Zimri.

9:43.note: Binea rendered 'the Canaanite'; Azel before Elasah.

9:44.note: Azrikam split into Azri and Qim; Bocheru read as 'his firstborn'; 'his son' after each.

10:3.note: Expanded: 'men skilled with the bow'; 'when Saul saw them he was very afraid of them' for 'he was wounded by the archers'.

10:4.note: Adds 'and kill me'; 'drew his sword' for 'took the sword'.

10:6.note: 'His armour-bearer and all his mighty men' for 'all his house'; adds 'on that day'.

10:7.note: Adds 'beyond the Jordan' and 'the people of Israel'; ethic dative with 'fled'; 'Saul was killed'.

10:9.note: Plural 'their heads, their armour'; 'to the villages, cities and towns' for 'round about'.

10:10.note: Corpses for skull; 'on the wall of Beth-shan' for 'house of Dagon'; adds 'their weapons'.

10:12.note: mare hayla = hayil; harmonised with 1 Sam 31: night march, taking bodies from the wall of Beth-shan and burning them.

10:13.note: 'Because he lied against the Lord'; 'to inquire' omitted.

10:14.note: 'He killed him' omitted; passive 'his kingdom was given'.

11:2.note: 'Over us' and 'at the head of' added; 'your God' omitted; 'all the tribes of Israel'.

11:3.note: 'Tribes' for 'elders'; 'covenant' rendered 'oath'; 'set up David to be king' for 'anointed as king'; 'the words of Samuel the prophet which he spoke in the name of the Lord'.

11:5.note: Adds 'David gathered all the people'; 'cities of Zion' for 'stronghold of Zion'.

11:6.note: kol man d- renders kol makke; expanded: 'king David appointed him head and chief of the army'.

11:8.note: Joab's repair replaced by 'David gave the right hand (= spared, yehayye) to the rest of the people in the cities'; David for Joab left as plus.

11:11.note: 'Who sat in the first seat' for Jashobeam; eight hundred for three hundred.

11:12.note: 'Three hundred men' for 'the three mighty men'; gentilic Ahohite as 'from Ahoh the city'.

11:13.note: 'Was there' added; 'one field sown with barley'.

11:15.note: 'Head on the rock' omitted; Adullam rendered Gatam; Rephaim rendered 'giants'.

11:18.note: Expanded: 'at that hour three men heard'; 'broke and entered' together render ויבקעו; 'great cistern', 'of the city', 'gave' are pluses; second 'David' omitted.

11:19.note: Rephrased: 'these men went at the risk of their necks'; 'shall I drink' omitted.

11:21.note: 'Thirty' for 'three'; בשנים omitted; 'and fought like the thirty' is a free rendering of ועד השלושה לא בא.

11:22.note: 'Lions of God' rendered 'mighty men'; 'whose deeds were good'.

11:23.note: 'Lord of strength' added; expanded description of the spear (thickness of its point); proleptic ܒܗ belongs to בחניתו.

11:25.note: 'Fought like the three' freely renders ואל השלושה לא בא; 'guard over his spear' for על משמעתו.

11:27.note: Gentilics rendered 'from the King's Mountain', 'from Paltun'.

11:35.note: Hararite rendered 'from Tur Beta'; adds 'from Bagraton'.

11:37.note: Naarai rendered Laʿzar; 'son of Ezbai' as 'from Obad'.

11:42.note: Expanded: 'he was head of the tribe of Reuben and ruler over thirty men'.

11:47.note: Adds Yithma and Ashkir; Mezobaite omitted.

12:1.note: Heavily expanded: prefaced by 'these are all David's mighty men', adds that they could have killed Saul but David did not let them.

12:2.note: Stones omitted; swords added; again David would not let them kill Saul (this Saul taken as MT's שאול); 'head of the tribe of Benjamin' for 'Saul's brothers' (ܪܫܐ may anticipate הראש of 12:3).

12:3.note: Adds heading 'these are the names of David's mighty men'; 'from Maskha' added; order of names varied.

12:4.note: 'Ruler over thirty and fought like all of them'.

12:9.note: Expanded ('mighty of stature', swords); 'colour of lions'; כצבאים read from צבא 'when they fight', למהר freely 'they uproot it'; spear omitted.

12:14.note: Jeremiah omitted; Shephatiah added as eleventh.

12:15.note: 'One ruling over a hundred and others over a thousand'; ܥܠ renders the ל- prefixes; 'small/great' omitted.

12:16.note: 'In the month Nisan'; ܟܕ = והוא; content of MT 12:24 joined here with plus 'that the word of Samuel the prophet be fulfilled' (pluses placed in 12:24).

12:18.note: Expanded: David blesses them; 'the Lord give you double for what is in your heart' paraphrases יהיה לי עליכם לבב ליחד; double rendering of בלא חמס; 'judge between us whoever deceives his fellow' added.

12:19.note: Expanded speech of Amasa son of Jether: לך read as 'come thou' (repeated), 'fear not', 'peace is given you from your helper'.

12:20.note: Rephrased: 'they did not want to go to war to help Saul because they hated him'; בראשינו rendered 'we will go first'; שלחהו omitted.

12:21.note: 'He would camp against him and seize him alive' added; name order varied.

12:22.note: Adds 'ruled over all the army and did as they pleased'.

12:23.note: 'Came to David to eat bread before him because he loved them' for 'to help him until a great camp'.

12:24.note: 'In the month Nisan'; ܟܕ = והוא; content of MT 12:24 joined here with plus 'that the word of Samuel the prophet be fulfilled' (pluses placed in 12:24).

12:30.note: 'Until the day Saul was killed' added; הנה apparently read as 'they'; מרביתם omitted.

12:33.note: Adds 'doing good and right works before the Lord'; 'what Israel should do' omitted.

12:34.note: 'Mighty men' added; בלא לב ולב rendered 'with all their heart' (moved forward); לעדר as 'to do battle'; adds 'against those divided over David's kingdom'.

12:41.note: Adds 'these are the names of the tribes'; 'baskets of grapes' for raisins; 'food' and cattle after mules omitted.

13:2.note: 'Let us ask of the Lord that he fence our breaches' paraphrases נפרצה; 'send' omitted; adds 'settle' and 'come'.

13:3.note: Bringing back the ark replaced by 'let us pray before the Lord our God and seek him for our sins'.

13:4.note: Second half (the thing was right in the eyes of all the people) omitted.

13:5.note: Shihor rendered 'river of Egypt'; Hamath rendered Antioch; Kiriath-jearim as Qurith Naʿrin.

13:6.note: Baalah omitted; 'border of the land of the tribe of Judah'; 'upon the high cherubim'.

13:7.note: Adds 'they carried it and went out'.

13:13.note: 'Did not want to bring in' = לא הסיר; adds 'of the Lord' and 'and David said that they should bring it'.

14:1.note: Adds 'and he sent him'; Ketiv/Qere Hiram.

14:3.note: Adds 'after he came from Hebron'; 'more' omitted.

14:10.note: 'The Lord' for 'God'; speaker 'the Lord' omitted in reply.

14:12.note: Adds 'to his mighty men' and 'scattered their dust to the wind'.

14:14.note: 'God' as speaker omitted; balsam trees omitted.

15:1.note: 'Built' for 'made/prepared'; 'pitched for it' omitted; 'equipment of the tent'.

15:2.note: Rendered positively without the negation ('none but the Levites'); adds 'and the equipment of the tent'.

15:5.note: Adds 'and he said to them'; 'elder' for 'chief'.

15:12.note: 'The place which was built for it formerly'.

15:13.note: Rephrased as 'lest the Lord our God break out against us'; 'at the first you were not' omitted.

15:18.note: Shemiramoth and Unni omitted; 'all these who stood at the gates'.

15:21.note: Elipheleh omitted; 'these minister' added; על השמינית interpreted as 'at the third, sixth and ninth hours', לנצח as 'every day'.

15:22.note: Chenaniah rendered Benaiah; יסר omitted; מבין apparently read as מכין 'prepared (was the place) for him'; ܒܡܛܠܐ tentatively the second במשא.

15:25.note: Adds 'to the city of David' and 'great'.

15:27.note: Singers and Chenaniah omitted; Levites also clothed in byssus.

15:28.note: Adds David; cymbals, harps, lyres reduced to 'horns straight and curved'.

16:1.note: 'Before the ark of the Lord' for 'before God'.

16:3.note: Adds 'from youths to sucklings'; numbers 'one' added; adds 'and all the people went each to his house' (cf. 16:43).

16:4.note: 'Before the Lord' for 'before the ark of the Lord'.

16:5.note: Shemiramoth, Obed-edom, Jeiel and instruments omitted; Amminadab, Nahziel and repeated Asaph added.

16:6.note: 'All these priests'; Benaiah and Jahaziel omitted; 'horns' for 'trumpets'.

16:7.note: 'David opened his mouth' for נתן דויד; adds 'all the priests and Levites' and the heading 'these are the heads of the praises which David spoke before the ark'.

16:13.note: 'Seed of Abraham' for 'seed of Israel'; adds 'whom he chose'.

16:16.note: 'Covenant he gave to the sons of Isaac' for 'his oath to Isaac'.

16:24.note: 'Among all the peoples his wonders' omitted.

16:29.note: Adds 'with the prayer of your mouth'.

16:33.note: Adds 'he will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in faithfulness' (Ps 96:13).

16:35.note: 'And say' (16:35) placed here. 'Save me, Lord'; first person singular; 'God of our salvation' rendered 'Lord'.

16:36.note: 'Lord of lords'; adds 'with sweet and pure mouth they praise their God'.

16:37.note: 'Before the Lord' for 'before the ark'; 'each one his day'.

16:38.note: 'The younger, his son'; 'all these keepers of the outer gates'.

16:39.note: Zadok rendered Hesron; adds 'all these priests who minister'; 'great high place'.

16:40.note: Adds 'by the hand of Moses to teach'.

16:41.note: Adds 'these are the names of the men who stood in praises'; 'righteous men' for 'chosen'.

16:42.note: Reinterpreted: they praised not with instruments, horns or cymbals but with sweet mouth and pure prayer to the Lord God almighty; gatekeepers omitted.

16:43.note: Adds 'David dismissed the people'; 'the sons of his house'.

17:1.note: 'Roofed house of cedar beams'; 'covenant' omitted; 'dwells within a tent of hair'.

17:5.note: Adds 'from the land of Egypt'; 'moving from tabernacle to tabernacle'.

17:6.note: Rephrased: 'behold how long I walked among all the sons of Israel'; 'roofed with cedars'.

17:9.note: 'To exile him' for 'to wear him out'.

17:10.note: 'I gave you rest'; ובית יבנה לך rendered 'that the kingdom is established for you', plus 'forever'.

17:11.note: 'From your loins' for 'from your sons'; 'you will be gathered'.

17:12.note: 'House for my name'; 'throne of his kingdom'.

17:14.note: 'I will make him rule' for 'I will establish him'.

17:16.note: 'Lord of lords' for 'LORD God'; adds 'considered before you'.

17:17.note: Second half replaced: 'all men who fear you with all their heart you bring out of darkness to light'.

17:18.note: 'Revealed are the deeds of your servant'; 'for honour' omitted.

17:19.note: 'Because (בעבור) you know what is in your servant's heart you did for him'; 'O Lord' and second 'great things' omitted; 'to your servant' added.

17:21.note: 'Revealed from heaven' for 'God went'; שם omitted ('signs great and fearful'); adds 'great plagues on the Egyptians'.

17:25.note: 'Revealed a secret'; 'build me a house'; adds 'this prayer'.

17:26.note: 'All your true words which you spoke to your servant are good'.

17:27.note: Adds 'from your blessing the houses of the righteous are blessed'.

18:1.note: Adds from 2 Sam 8:1 'David took the measuring line from the hand of the Philistines'; 'the villages around it'.

18:3.note: Zobah rendered Nisibis; Hamath omitted; 'set the border' for 'establish his hand'.

18:5.note: Reads Edom for Aram; Zobah rendered Nisibis.

18:7.note: 'Which hung on the horses of the servants'; bringing to Jerusalem omitted.

18:8.note: David (not Solomon) made the sea and pillars; adds 'bulls of bronze'.

18:9.note: Tou rendered Pul king of the Antiochians; Zobah rendered Nisibis.

18:10.note: Hadoram rendered Yoram; 'a warrior was Hadadezer'; adds 'in Yoram's hand were'; Ketiv/Qere לשאול/לשאל.

18:11.note: Adds 'whom he subdued'; Ammon before Moab.

18:16.note: Abimelech rendered Ahimelech; Shavsha rendered Sharia.

18:17.note: Cherethites and Pelethites rendered 'archers and slingers'; 'at the king's side' omitted.

19:3.note: 'Their lord' added; 'in his life' stands in the slot of בעיניך; 'to spy the city and know its exits and entrances'.

19:4.note: 'Shaved half their beards and half their heads'.

19:6.note: Aram-maacah rendered Haran; Zobah rendered Nisibis; adds Edom.

19:7.note: 'Horsemen' for 'chariots'; adds kings of Edom, Aram-naharaim and Nisibis.

19:12.note: Aram rendered Edom; adds 'come' and 'from them'.

19:16.note: Aram rendered Edomites; adds 'they came to Hilam' (2 Sam 10:16).

19:17.note: Crossing the Jordan and first 'arranged' omitted; Aram rendered Edomites.

19:18.note: Aram rendered Edomites; 'four thousand' for 'forty thousand'.

20:1.note: 'Next year'; 'gathered the armies, came and camped against the land of the Ammonites and seized it'; 'Rabbath their great city'.

20:2.note: 'Their king's crown'; adds 'he weighed it'; 'good gems' for 'precious stone'.

20:3.note: 'Bound them with chains and iron fetters' for sawing; adds that he killed none of them and settled them in the cities of Israel.

20:4.note: Gezer rendered Gaza; Rephaim rendered 'reproachful giant'; 'were subdued' omitted.

20:5.note: Battle and Elhanan's slaying of Lahmi omitted; 'the point of his spear was thick' for ועץ חניתו.

20:6.note: Adds 'fingers of his hands and feet' and 'in number'.

21:2.note: Syriac adds "son of Zeruiah" and "of the people".

21:3.note: Free paraphrase: adds "and may the eyes of my lord the king see"; "why should it be a guilt to Israel" missing.

21:5.note: Adds "footmen", "tribe of the house of", "in the number"; "all" omitted.

21:6.note: Adds "priests" and a closing clause that Joab did not want to count them.

21:7.note: Reads "concerning that David counted Israel" instead of "and he smote Israel".

21:9.note: Adds "David rose in the morning" (cf. 2 Sam 24:11); "David's seer" rendered "prophet".

21:12.note: Free rendering of the sword clause; pestilence/angel clause compressed to "in Israel".

21:15.note: Adds "you have destroyed"; "when he was destroying it".

21:17.note: הלא omitted; 'very great is the folly that I committed' renders the infinitive-absolute construction והרע הרעותי; adds 'innocent' lambs.

21:20.note: Different text: 'David saw (וירא) the angel (את המלאך) destroying the people, that he withdrew his hand'; Ornan, his sons and threshing omitted.

21:21.note: Order changed: Ornan bows first, then goes out from the threshing floor.

21:25.note: Price "fifty shekels" (cf. 2 Sam 24:24) instead of 600 shekels of gold.

21:29.note: Adds "he prayed there before" and "at the exodus of the Israelites from Egypt"; altar/Gibeon clause missing.

21:30.note: Opening 'at that time' is MT 21:29 בעת ההיא (not available as target here); adds 'David feared greatly'.

22:2.note: "All" and "of them" added; "to build" paraphrased as "for the house".

22:3.note: Expanded: "to make of them smiths, workers of iron, to make nails, clamps and fittings of iron"; doors of gates omitted.

22:4.note: Tyrians and Sidonians in reversed order.

22:5.note: Heavily expanded: "it is said of him in the book", "everything needed"; "before his death" rendered "from my life".

22:6.note: MT 22:7 has no counterpart; adds "Lord of lords"; "commanded" rendered "said".

22:8.note: "The word of the Lord came to me" rendered "he sent to me by the hand of the prophet".

22:10.note: Adds "I will be"; "for ever and ever".

22:14.note: Greatly expanded with repeated "I have prepared for you" and "no man on earth can count it"; "in my affliction" omitted.

22:16.note: Adds "workers of" before each metal; "with you" as "in your help".

22:17.note: "Princes" rendered "elders"; adds "and said to them"; "his son" as "my son".

22:18.note: Double rendering 'helps you and aids you' for והניח לכם; 'given into my hand' rendered 'delivered before you'.

22:19.note: Adds "in which is laid", "our God", "his great name that is called upon us".

23:2.note: "Princes of Israel" rendered "elders of the priests and Levites".

23:4.note: Greatly expanded with a long plus on overseers of alms and the poor; numbers recast as 'men over a thousand / six each over a hundred' (hundred in the slot of אלפים); MT 23:5 has no counterpart.

23:9.note: Ketiv/qere Shelomoth; reads "of Shimei" for "of Laadan".

23:14.note: "Man of God" rendered "prophet of the Lord"; "his sons" omitted.

23:25.note: "LORD God of" rendered "Lord of lords"; adds "from now".

23:26.note: Negation missing: the Levites shall carry the tabernacle.

23:28.note: החצרות read as trumpets ('those who blow straight and curved horns'); הלשכות as 'chests in which they store the holy vessels'; service and purification omitted.

23:29.note: "Praising and confessing" anticipates v. 30; griddle and mixed offering omitted.

24:2.note: "Before their father" rendered "in the lifetime of Aaron their father".

24:4.note: Adds "and they were in number" and "heads of men".

24:5.note: "Princes of God" rendered "rulers of the priests".

24:6.note: "Princes" rendered "elders of Israel"; adds "David"; "taken" rendered "one ... another".

24:7.note: Word-for-word with ordinal before the name.

24:11.note: Ordinal precedes name; Jeshua read Elisha.

24:12.note: Ordinal precedes name; Eliashib and Jakim read Elisha and Eliqreb.

24:13.note: Ordinal precedes name; Jeshebeab read Hadia.

24:17.note: Ordinal precedes name; Jachin read Nakhnam.

24:19.note: "By the hand" rendered "by the counsel"; adds "as was required for them"; "Lord God" as "Lord of lords".

24:23.note: Only names kept; ordinals and "sons of" omitted.

24:26.note: Only "sons of Jaaziah his son"; MT 24:26a and 24:27-29 have no counterpart.

24:31.note: Reversed: "the small like his brother the elder, thus was reckoned"; adds "in reckoning and number".

25:1.note: Only the closing clause is rendered; David's separation of Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun with instruments is missing.

25:2.note: "Under the hand of Asaph who prophesied" omitted; "whom the king delivered".

25:3.note: Gedaliah missing, Jeduthun added to the list; "prophesying" omitted.

25:4.note: List breaks off after Hananiah; MT 25:4b-6 have no counterpart.

25:7.note: "Instructed in song" rendered "praising"; "all who were skilled" recast as "the number of these singers".

25:8.note: Casting of lots omitted; "small as great was reckoned, pupil as teacher".

25:29.note: Word-for-word; Giddalti read Yarbi; MT 25:30-31 have no counterpart.

26:1.note: "Porters" rendered "gates ... guards"; adds "which King David appointed"; Korahites and "son of Kore" omitted; Asaph read Joseph.

26:8.note: Adds "of the holy house" and "sons of".

26:10.note: Shimri omitted; "not firstborn" expanded to "his eldest son had died ... and he did not call him by the name of seniority".

27:11.note: "Of the Zarhites" rendered "of the house of Zerah".

27:12.note: Ketiv/qere Benjaminite rendered "of the house of Benjamin".

27:13.note: "Of the Zarhites" rendered "of the house of Zerah".

27:15.note: "Of Othniel" rendered "of the house of Othniel".

28:1.note: "Eunuchs" rendered "faithful ones"; adds "and they all came".

28:2.note: "Rose to his feet" omitted; "footstool" rendered "place of his Shekhina".

28:3.note: Doubles the causal clause ("because you are a man who shed much blood").

28:5.note: "Kingdom of the Lord" rendered "exalted kingdom of Israel".

28:7.note: Condition negated: "unless he does not wish to keep"; adds "throne".

28:8.note: "Good land" rendered "this land"; adds "for ever" and "and not be destroyed".

28:9.note: "Know the God of your father" rendered "know all that the Lord our God commanded"; adds "without compulsion"; "forever" omitted.

28:10.note: Adds "to the name of his holiness of the Lord" and "be strong".

28:11.note: Free summary of MT 28:11-19 with Greek loanwords (prostas) and a list of houses, lamps, tables and vessels; MT 28:12-19 have no own verses.

28:13.note: Free summary of MT 28:11-19 with Greek loanwords (prostas) and a list of houses, lamps, tables and vessels; MT 28:12-19 have no own verses.

28:14.note: Free summary of MT 28:11-19 with Greek loanwords (prostas) and a list of houses, lamps, tables and vessels; MT 28:12-19 have no own verses.

28:15.note: Free summary of MT 28:11-19 with Greek loanwords (prostas) and a list of houses, lamps, tables and vessels; MT 28:12-19 have no own verses.

28:16.note: Free summary of MT 28:11-19 with Greek loanwords (prostas) and a list of houses, lamps, tables and vessels; MT 28:12-19 have no own verses.

28:19.note: Free summary of MT 28:11-19 with Greek loanwords (prostas) and a list of houses, lamps, tables and vessels; MT 28:12-19 have no own verses.

28:20.note: "LORD God my God" rendered "Lord of lords".

28:21.note: Expanded with appointed rulers and Gershon the treasurer; "the people" omitted.

29:1.note: Expanded: Solomon is "young but wise and prudent", and an exhortation "be strong"; "the palace" omitted.

29:2.note: Adds "all my possessions", "cedars" and "pearls"; onyx, inlay, antimony and marble omitted.

29:3.note: Paraphrase: "everything needed I prepared ... from my poverty" for "my own treasure ... over and above all".

29:4.note: "3000 talents" rendered "a thousand thousand talents ... twice"; Ophir rendered "good gold"; "refined" omitted.

29:5.note: "Gold for gold" rendered "where gold is needed"; the call for volunteers replaced by a plus about completing the work.

29:7.note: Darics rendered "ingots of good selones, 200 thousand"; copper "Corinthian", 70 thousand.

29:8.note: "Precious stones" rendered "silver and gold as needed"; Jehiel the Gershonite rendered "Gershon the treasurer".

29:9.note: Gifts attributed to David; adds "and he praised the Lord with great praises".

29:11.note: Adds "honour", "wisdom, might and knowledge"; "all" in heaven and earth rendered "you rule".

29:14.note: After "who am I and who is my people" the Syriac diverges completely ("from all my teachers I learned ... you are our hope").

29:15.note: Free rendering: 'we are likened to the vapour of a pot' for כצל, 'small in the world' for על הארץ; 'you ruled over our fathers of old' echoes ככל אבתינו; גרים, ימינו and ואין מקוה have no counterpart.

29:16.note: Different text: praise for deliverance from the nations who taunt "where is your God".

29:18.note: "Imagination of thoughts" rendered "turn our heart from evil that we not sin"; adds "I David answered and said thus".

29:19.note: "Palace" rendered "house"; adds a closing plea for the sanctification of the great name.

29:20.note: Adds "of Israel" and "and they blessed also King David".

29:26.note: "David reigned" rendered "David made Solomon his son king".

29:28.note: Adds "David son of Jesse", "old", "grew rich with riches of the world".

29:30.note: Adds a closing plus on David doing what was pleasing before the Lord all his days.
